description: This Java class serves as a global exception handler for a Spring Boot web application, managing validation errors, not-found exceptions, and generic unexpected exceptions, providing standardized HTTP responses.

classes.name: GlobalExceptionHandler
classes.description: A controller advice class that handles exceptions globally across the application, returning appropriate HTTP responses.

methods.name: handleValidation
methods.description: Handles validation errors resulting from invalid method arguments, returning a detailed error response with specific field errors.

methods.name: handleNotFound
methods.description: Handles NotFoundException specifically, returning a 404 Not Found response with a message.

methods.name: handleGeneric
methods.description: Handles all other exceptions, returning a 500 Internal Server Error response with a generic message.
